stage2_pipeline_notes.hifi_circumstellar_outflow_mol: All 5 qualified Herschel HIFI detections match resolved circumstellar wind profiles (FWHM 6.82-14.96 km/s) and CO 10-9 / SO rotational transitions in AGB/OHM control envelopes.
stage2_pipeline_notes.spire_pacs_cdms_jpl_atlas: All 35 SPIRE FTS and 1 PACS qualified features match known CDMS/JPL transitions (HCN, HCN v2=1, 13CO, o/p-H2O, CH+, CO 20-19) within <0.22 um (<0.5 px).
stage2_pipeline_notes.stis_extended_pn_bk_overshoot: All 4 qualified STIS E140H peaks occur exclusively in extended-PN control NGC7027 and exhibit CALSTIS background-strip negative-flux overshoot troughs (min_z <= -5) bracketing bright nebular knots.
stage2_pipeline_notes.optical_feros_g8_cr_ringing: Gate G8 is fit on canonical clean background patches (bg_feats, 117/120 calibration). All 241 optical/K_PLANET G8 survivors across FEROS/HARPS resolve physically via airglow/OH wing, local P90 trough, low-continuum SNR<8 / CR extraction ringing (incl. GJ1005 3984.56 A), single-exposure unflagged ADP CR with 0 clean repeats (incl. ALTAIR 3707.42 A), and <2-epoch K_PLANET coherence (#139 GJ680) -> 0 verified ETI.
stage2_pipeline_notes.rapid_rotator_rv_fallback: For extreme rapid rotators (e.g., ALTAIR vsini~240 km/s, anchor scatter 39.43 km/s > 8.0 km/s), Stage B uses locked SIMBAD prior_rv_kms (-26.1 km/s) for rest-frame spectral alignment while recording empirical scatter in STAR_RV_SUMMARY_D097.csv.
stage2_pipeline_notes.drift_v55_physical_triage: Stage-2 re-checks raw continuum ratio against 90th-percentile local flux, OH/telluric airglow coincidence and topocentric peak stability (including APOGEE-2 16352.9 A fixed sky residual verified across KEPLER37/KEPLER93), stationary stellar/telluric absorption trough dominance (rejecting BERV-shifted 8280-8284 A H2O template-trough residuals such as HNLIB), epoch distribution uniformity, and coadded shifted LSF shape.
stage2_pipeline_notes.rpca_cal_apogee2_alignment: RPCA calibration benchmark uses SDSS_APOGEE2 15200-15364 A config matching injection grid spacing.
